title: Exact Rational LDL^T Gram Certification and Constructive Lean 4 Formalization of Real Equiangular Lines in Dimensions 18-20 and Sharp Fixed-Angle Bounds
abstract: Djaljapayan, Liao, and Yu (arXiv:2611.34855v1, Nov. 2026) determine the last three open maximum real equiangular line counts through dimension 41, proving N(18)=57, N(19)=72, and N(20)=90, together with explicit sharp fixed-angle intervals N_{1/q}(d)=d+7 (q>=319) and N_{1/q}(d)=d+23 (q>=5599), a quadratic-irrational conference-matrix family, and N_{1/7}(10)=12, N_{1/7}(11)=13. We provide an independent, unrefereed companion certification suite (EQUIANGULAR-18-20-CERT-1.0) comprising: (i) 18 constructive Lean 4.35.0 theorems (0 sorry, 0 custom axioms, 0 Classical.choice); (ii) exact rational pivoted LDL^T Gram certifications of the 57-line R^18 configuration, the binary [23,12,7] Golay code and nested Leech-lattice sections 276 -> 176 -> 126 -> 90 from R^23 into R^22, R^21, R^20, explicit q=19 Seidel systems in R^49-R^51, Paley conference matrices, and cosine-1/7 systems; and (iii) 16 canonical JSON certificates and 27 unit/forgery/AST tests.
